Ukuqala okusheshayo
 1. Faka i-Torque Pro (inguqulo ekhokhelwayo; i-Torque Lite ayisekeli ama-plugin) bese ubhangqa i-adaptha ye-OBD-II.
 2. Vula le plugin ku-Torque → Izilungiselelo → Plugins.
 3. Vumela izaziso, bese usetha ukusetshenziswa kwebhethri kube Okungenamkhawulo ukuze i-Torque iqale le plugin ngemuva.
 4. Ku-Torque, khetha iphrofayela yemoto oyishayelayo. Idatha igcinwa ngephrofayela ngayinye ye-Torque futhi ihlolwa nobunikazi be-VIN/ECU yemoto.
 5. Kuphrofayela entsha umthombo kaphethiloli utholwa uma uxhuma; uma ubuzwa, uqhathanise negedi yedeshboard bese uthinta Qinisekisa. U-Qinisekisa usekhasini lokusetha nasesazisweni. Ungakhetha nangezansi.
 6. Usayizi wethangi uwusayizi wokuqala we-Chunk fit kuze ifunde owakhe. I-plugin ayiwushintshi; usayizi ofundiwe we-fit ngayinye uboniswa ngaphansi kwayo.
 7. Ku-Torque, engeza amagedi e-[FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level nawo wonke we-Corrected %, Remaining, DTE kanye ne-Tank size. I-DTE i-Remaining iphindaphindwe nge-mpg yesikhathi eside ye-Torque. Isaziso ngesikhathi se-refit sithi leyo fit ifunda u-1:1 kuze kuphele i-refit.
 8. Buyisela izinga likaphethiloli ku-Torque: Valiwe, bushelelezi, noma kulungisiwe kusuka ku-Chunk, Band noma Kalman fit kuya kugedi yakho ye-012F.
 9. Uphethiloli ubalwa kuphela ngenkathi injini isebenza. I-plugin isebenza kuphela ngenkathi i-Torque ixhunywe ku-ECU.
 10. Qhubeka ushayela futhi ugcwalisa; ukunemba kukhula emathangini amaningana angagcwele. Uma kuvela isaziso sephrofayela yemoto engalungile?, khetha okufanele kwenziwe ngaleyo ndawo yokushayela.
 11. Yonke idatha ihlala kule foni. Akukho GPS noma indawo eqoshiwayo.

Ukuqala ngebhethri noma ngemuva kunqatshiwe. Vula kanye ukuze i-plugin isebenze ne-Torque.

Engeza amathangi angaphezulu njengoba kudingeka (ithangi lefemula 1 lihlala njalo). Ungashintshi abathumeli baye kuphini ye-PCM FLI (ukugcwalisa okungamanga). Ithangi ngalinye elingeziwe lidinga i-PID eyengeziwe ye-Torque yalo (MCU Mode 22, igama eliyingqayizivele — hhayi i-012F noma i-Ford 16C1). Inani le-Select-PID yi-id yethangi eqala ku-1. I-Gal/hr ikhokhiswa ethangini elisebenzayo kuphela.
Usayizi wethangi uwusayizi wokuqala we-Chunk fit kuze ifunde owakhe. I-plugin ayiwushintshi; usayizi ofundiwe we-fit ngayinye uboniswa ngaphansi kwayo.

Ibhala inani ku-Fuel Level yefemula ye-Torque (012F) ukuze amagedi akhona akubonise: Valiwe, bushelelezi, noma kulungisiwe kusuka ku-Chunk, Band noma Kalman fit. I-fit engakakhiwa ibhala izinga elibushelelezi.
Kudingeka i-Torque Pro (ekhokhelwayo). I-Torque Lite ayisekeli ama-plugin.
Igama lale phrofayela yemoto. Iphrofayela ngayinye yemoto ye-Torque ithola iphrofayela ye-plugin, idatha, namamephu afundiwe ayo.
Umenzi wemoto (isb. Ford). Kusetshenziswa ukukhetha ukuthi yimaphi ama-PID kaphethiloli omkhiqizo ukuthola okuzowazama.

Izinga elingahluziwe likaphethiloli livela kuphi. Thola (i-ECU kumele ixhunyiwe) ifunda abangenele kuphela futhi icela ukuqinisekisa ngaphandle uma imithombo emibili ivumelana. U-Qinisekisa usekhasini lokusetha nasesazisweni. Akukho = thola ekuxhumaneni okulandelayo.
Komthombo we-Torque extra PID by long name kuphela: igama elide eliqondile le-PID ye-Torque ebika izinga.
akunalutho = awukho usayizi wokuqala; i-fit ngayinye ifunda eyayo.
Ukuma kwesikhathi kwesihlungi sokubusheleleza (0 = akukho ukubusheleleza).
Ushintsho olukhulu ngomzuzwana izinga elibushelelezi elingalilandela; ukushukuma okudlula lokhu kuyashiywa.
Ukukhuphuka kwezinga ngenkathi umile okubalwa njengokugcwalisa.
Ongakukhetha: faka ukufundwa kwe-odometer bese Londoloza uphini ukuze ubambe ibanga lale phrofayela.
Ukushiswa kukaphethiloli (gal/hr) kukhokhiswa kuliphi ithangi. Kusuka ku-PID: i-PID ye-Torque ikhetha (i-id yethangi eqala ku-1).
Kuphela uma Ithangi elisebenzayo = Kusuka ku-PID: igama elide le-PID ye-Torque inani layo okuyi-id yethangi.
Igama elide elenziwe ngokwezifiso lethangi %1$d (isb. [FuelSmooth] Tank%1$d Level)
Torque extra PID by long name
I-Fuel Smoothing i-refit imephu ye-%1$s. Leyo fit ifunda u-1:1 kuze kuphele i-refit.
I-Fuel Smoothing ayinawo umthombo wezinga likaphethiloli lwe-%1$s. Vula ikhasi lokusetha bese uthinta Thola, noma ukhethe umthombo.
I-%1$s ayinikezanga izinga elisebenzisekayo le-%2$s. Hlola ukuxhumana kwe-adaptha, noma usebenzise u-Thola ekhasini lokusetha.
Vula ukusetha kwe-Fuel Smoothing bese ukhetha umthombo (noma ungeze i-PID ku-Torque), bese uthinta Thola.
Kutholwe i-%1$s, ukufundwa okungu-%2$.0f %% kwe-%3$s. Hlola ukuthi kufana negedi kaphethiloli yedeshboard, bese uthinta Qinisekisa. U-Qinisekisa usekhasini lokusetha nasesazisweni (%4$s).
Kutholwe i-%1$s ye-%2$s. Hlola ukuthi kufana negedi kaphethiloli yedeshboard, bese uthinta Qinisekisa. U-Qinisekisa usekhasini lokusetha nasesazisweni (%3$s).
Le moto iyi-%1$s (%2$s), kodwa iphrofayela ye-Torque iyi-\'%3$s\'. Idatha iya ku-%1$s; thepha ukuze uvule i-Torque futhi ushintshe iphrofayela.
Iphrofayela ye-Torque \'%1$s\' ayifani nale moto (%2$s). Isiphakamiso: %3$s. Idatha ibanjwa bese ilahlwa ekupheleni kokushayela ngaphandle kokuthi uyigcine.
Lokhu kushayela kuzolondolozwa ku-%1$s. I-API ye-plugin ye-Torque ayikwazi ukudala noma ukushintsha amaphrofayela e-Torque: ku-Torque, dala noma ukhethe iphrofayela yemoto ebizwa ngokuthi \'%2$s\'.
